issues.title: Playing downloaded song from artist page fetches the song online instead of locally
issues.notes: Top candidate this run. Real defect confirmed in MusicService.kt:createDataSourceFactory (queue-supplied SongItem.toMediaMetadata() never carries isLocal/localPath, so the DB fallback never runs). Confidently explains the custom/external-download failure mode; does not confidently explain the internal-download failure mode the reporter also describes (that path uses downloadCache.isCached() by mediaId, independent of queue metadata). No logs/stack trace/viewable recording. build_capability=none this run caps verifiability low. Did not clear the 80 gate (55/100).

issues.title: Authentication Tokens Stored in Plaintext
issues.notes: Hard abort: fix needs either a new dependency (androidx.security-crypto, requires editing gradle/libs.versions.toml — forbidden) or touching ~10 call sites with no shared token accessor plus a migration for existing plaintext values, well past blast-radius limits. Precisely localized (PreferenceKeys.kt:204-208, DataStore.kt:24) but blocked on scope, not evidence.

issues.title: Scrollbar flickering / scroll bar jumping / scrollbar skipping or glitching
issues.notes: Root cause confirmed to live in third-party dependency com.github.nanihadesuka:LazyColumnScrollbar (gradle/libs.versions.toml:45) — InterTune's own wrapper (ui/component/ScrollBar.kt:18-19) already documents the exact upstream bug (nanihadesuka/LazyColumnScrollbar#40). Hard abort per Phase 2 rule: root cause in a third-party library.

issues.title: Searching "null" results in a crash
issues.notes: Already fixed in this fork. Verified directly: MainActivity.kt:730-733 declares the search route's query nav arg nullable=true, and OnlineSearchViewModel.kt:27 recovers via `?: "null"` instead of `!!`. Both guard against androidx.navigation's StringType treating the literal path segment "null" as its null sentinel. LocalSearchViewModel.kt never routes through nav args at all, so it was never exposed either.
